notes.title: 8/31 Some Demo Fixes
notes.content:
Hey, everyone, hope you're enjoying the demo!  We had a small hotfix that addressed a few, mostly minor errors, though there were a couple of potential game-breaking bugs that we got.

Patch Notes:

 Disabled combos if any of the required actors were already casting
 Fixed crash when combo actor was unavailable at time of combo execution
 Fixed Status Effects being applied multiple times instead of refreshing.
 Fixed Counters being applied multiple times instead of refreshing
 Fixed Counters not displaying their duration
 Fixed leader colliding with object post battle when in a specific battle position
 Reduced the range that the scrapped wall text can be interacted with
 Fixed spelling error on potion descriptions
